response.original_title: 2 or 3 things I Know About Her
response.overview: Consumerism, modern life, alienation, sex, and politics. Radical French New Wave film by Jean-Luc Godard, starring Marina Vlady as a suburban housewife who turns to prostitution to cope. Experimental and fragmented, featuring Godard's direct-to-camera narration and philosophical digressions, often breaking the fourth wall. Included among the “1001 Movies You Must See Before You Die,” edited by Steven Schneider.
